name: Application-Specific Computer Architectures
description: Fundamentals: instruction set architecture (ISA), pipelining, performance metrics. Data path and control unit design implementation, arithmetic and logic unit (ALU) design, memory hierarchy: caches, virtual memory, and TLB. RISC-V architecture and open-source hardware. Advanced pipelining and instruction-level parallelism (ILP): pipeline hazards and their resolution: data, control, and structural hazards. Superscalar architectures. Dynamic scheduling: Tomasulo’s algorithm. Branch prediction and speculative execution. Parallel architectures: multicore and multiprocessor systems, shared-memory versus message-passing architectures, GPU architectures and GPU programming.
